claims.statement: Commonworld's own paid check (research observation, micropay test 2026-11-01): the live 402 of https://api.402rates.com/v1/ping asked 0.001 USDC (x402 v2, scheme exact) with payTo 0xf567Cfe0FDb87A1D6Ca330e3f30f0D3DA0F7cb98 on Base, Polygon and Arbitrum, and payTo 0xedb1a894761F0a142d80D09F82Ff7CF99158Bb19 on XDC (eip155:50); the CDP Bazaar link on this card uses the XDC address. Commonworld paid once on Base and got a pong. Settlement: Base tx 0x4c0771d755ddd87e4deee4bbe1b1a6cb0dc61c23b1595c729cc7ecf0b605f3d9 (block 53349502), 0.001 USDC to the Base payTo. YourAITools lists the price as $0.001-$0.03.
